## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0 both signs → side + frequency content for the fan

Step 3 of `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`. Run 6: electron, n = +3.2×10¹² (F_L = 33.1 T), B 0→10 T (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above — FFT reads only the 10 mT leg, the coarse leg under-samples the tones). Run 7: hole, n = −1.2×10¹² (F_L = 12.4 T), 20 mT ride-down 10→0.3 T. Rxx = (sr1_X/gain)/I_drain (measured sr0 current), onset via `sdh_onset`, FFT via `sdh_fft` (bg poly deg 5 in B, two cutoffs for stability). Model markers from `fs_count_b0` at the run-5 calibration densities.

# Runs 6-7 spot-check read: raw -> bg-subtracted 1/B -> FFT vs F_L + model tones
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, resolve_channels, current_channel

def spot_channels(r):
    """Gain-divided Rxx = (V_sr1/gain)/I_drain (measured sr0), ascending in B."""
    chans = resolve_channels(r.meta)
    cur = current_channel(chans)
    v = [c for c in chans if c.cid == "sr1"][0]
    I = r.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    R = np.abs((r.col(v.col) / v.gain) / I)
    B = r.col("magnet_field")
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return B[o], R[o], np.abs(I[o])

def spot_read(rid, F_L, model, fft_cut, title):
    r = run(rid)
    print(summarize_run(r))
    B, R, I = spot_channels(r)
    m = B > 0.05
    B, R = B[m], R[m]
    r_fs = 50e-6 / np.nanmedian(I)   # sr1 sens 50 uV over measured I_bias
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=r_fs)
    print(on.summary())

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 3.6))
    # raw FIRST
    ax[0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6, color="k")
    ax[0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0].set_ylabel(r"$R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)")
    ax[0].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — {title}")
    # background-subtracted vs 1/B (bg poly in B per recipe)
    msk = B >= fft_cut
    dR = R[msk] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B[msk], R[msk], 5), B[msk])
    ax[1].plot(1 / B[msk], dR, lw=0.6)
    ax[1].set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax[1].set_ylabel(r"$\Delta R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)")
    ax[1].set_title(f"bg-subtracted, B > {fft_cut:g} T")
    # FFT, two cutoffs (stability), F_L + model tone markers
    for cut in (fft_cut, fft_cut * 1.3):
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max()), bg_degree=5, log=False)
        ax[2].plot(f, s[0] / s[0].max(), lw=0.8, label=f"cutoff {cut:.2f} T")
    ax[2].axvline(F_L, color="k", ls=":", lw=1, label=f"$F_L$ = {F_L:.1f} T")
    for lab, fm in model.items():
        ax[2].axvline(fm, color="tab:red", ls="--", lw=0.7, alpha=0.6)
        ax[2].text(fm, 1.02, lab, fontsize=7, ha="center", color="tab:red")
    ax[2].set_xlim(0, 1.35 * F_L)
    ax[2].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[2].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm)")
    ax[2].legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper right")
    print(f"FFT window [{fft_cut:g}, {B.max():g}] T -> record resolution dF = "
          f"{1 / (1 / fft_cut - 1 / B.max()):.2f} T")
    return on

# Run 6, electron n = +3.2e12: F_L = 33.1 T; fs_count_b0 model: ABAB pair
# 7.3/25.8 T (m* 0.027/0.061), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074).
on6 = spot_read(6, 33.1, {"ABAB f1": 7.3, "ABAB f2": 25.8, "ABCA": 33.1}, 1.0,
                "e-side n=+3.2e12")
f1, f2 = 7.1, 22.2
print(f"\nLuttinger: f1 + f2 = {f1 + f2:.1f} T = {(f1 + f2) / 33.1:.3f} x F_L "
      f"(lever-arm scale prior 0.8-1.2); partition {f1/(f1+f2):.2f}/{f2/(f1+f2):.2f} "
      f"vs model ABAB 0.22/0.78 at n = 3.2e12")

# Run 7, hole n = -1.2e12: F_L = 12.4 T; model: ABAB pair 5.3/7.1 T (the
# near-CNP close-and-balanced exception regime), ABCA 12.4 T (m* ~ 1, LK-dead
# at T_e ~ 8 K). 20 mT grid: tones > ~13 T alias below ~1.3 T; cutoff 0.8 keeps
# the dominant pair Nyquist-clean.
on7 = spot_read(7, 12.4, {"ABAB f1": 5.3, "ABAB f2": 7.1, "ABCA": 12.4}, 0.8,
                "h-side n=-1.2e12")
print(f"\nLuttinger: 4.7 + 6.6 = 11.3 T = {11.3/12.4:.3f} x F_L "
      f"(e-side scale 0.885 — consistent global rescale ~0.89-0.91)")

**Read (Step 3 verdict): electron side is the fan side; two-tone ABAB-consistent content, decision deferred to the fan's n-tracks.**

- **Run 6 (e, n = +3.2×10¹²):** two tones with *independent* onsets and envelopes — f₁ = 7.1 T (onset ≤ 0.3 T, censored at the record edge) and f₂ = 22.2 T (onset 1.33 T, snr 100) — plus 14.1 T (= 2f₁) and 29.5 T (≈ f₁+f₂ = 29.3 or 4f₁ = 28.4; unresolved at δF ≈ 1.1 T). Luttinger: f₁+f₂ = 29.3 T = **0.885·F_L** (inside the lever-arm prior), partition **0.24/0.76** vs model ABAB **0.22/0.78**. Caveats the fan must resolve: (a) `sdh_onset` flags f₂ ~3×f₁ (ratio 3.13) — a harmonic-comb reading (7.1 comb, single pocket at 0.21·F_L) fails Luttinger badly but 22.2 vs 21.3 is inside this record's δF; a real f₂ follows its own Onsager curve across n while a harmonic tracks 3f₁ exactly (model: f₂/f₁ sweeps 17→3.5 over n = 1→3.2×10¹²). (b) The 29.5 T tone (snr 87) sits at ≈ 0.89·F_L — ABAB breakdown/sum orbit (symmetry-allowed) *or* an ABCA-domain singleton sharing the same F_L: the F_L-tone-origin discrimination (B-window split, n-track, LK) is mandatory before any call. Low tones 3.0/4.2/5.2 T are censored-at-edge and near-residual — background/coarse-leg suspects, not claimed.
- **Run 7 (h, n = −1.2×10¹²):** multi-tone and messy — 4.7 + 6.6 T pair (+ harmonics 9.4/14.8/26.2), an 8.5 T tone, and a strong 12.3 T (snr 124) near F_L. This is the model's predicted near-CNP hole exception regime (close, balanced pair); onset higher (0.71 T vs ≤ 0.3). Luttinger on the pair: 11.3 = 0.91·F_L, consistent with the e-side scale. Hole side reaches only |n| = 1.27×10¹² (TG limit) — never leaves the exception regime → **not fannable for the call**.
- **Both sides give the same global density rescale (~0.89) → the run-5 geometry-prior lever arms are ~10% high, coherently.** Onset for fan design: ≤ 0.3 T at n = 3.2×10¹² (censored — a lower bound is enough since the fan's B_lo is set by partner-period coverage, not onset).
- **Handoff to Step 4 (`landau-fan-vti`):** electron side, D = 0, n = 1.0→3.2×10¹²; Δ(1/B) = 0.0099 T⁻¹ (⅓-Nyquist on F_L(3.2e12) = 33.6 T); B 0.6→10 T (5 partner periods down to n ≈ 1.9×10¹²; δF = 0.64 T); inherit sr1 50 µV and τ = 0.3 s/24 dB.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`), electron side, D = 0, n = 1.0→3.2×10¹², B 0.6→10 T

> **05:30** · LK fan e-side: D=0 n-line 3.2->1.0e12 (121 pts, Vtg 0.35..0.98, Vbg 0.35..1.17), B 0.6->10 T uniform-1/B 160 rows (d(1/B)=0.0099), sr1 50 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s (6tau), leak trip 1 nA; ends 10 T · **ETA ~20:30** (≈15h)

**Why now:** the spot checks (runs 6–7, ana cells 14–17) picked the electron side — run 6 shows a two-tone set (7.1 + 22.2 T) whose Luttinger sum is 0.885·F_L with partition 0.24/0.76 vs model-ABAB 0.22/0.78; the hole side is confined to the near-CNP exception regime by the TG limit. The fan's n-tracks decide what run 6 alone cannot: (a) is 22.2 T a real pocket (own Onsager curve; model f₂/f₁ sweeps 17→3.5 over this window) or a 3rd harmonic of 7.1 (tracks 3f₁ exactly)? (b) is the 29.5 T ≈ 0.89·F_L tone an ABAB breakdown/sum orbit or an ABCA-domain singleton (F_L-origin discrimination: n-track + B-window split + later LK)?

**Design (computed, `fs_count_b0` + base step-1 floors):** fastest expected content = F_L(3.2e12) = 33.6 T → Δ(1/B) = 0.0099 T⁻¹ (⅓-Nyquist); **B 0.6→10 T uniform in 1/B, N_B = 160** (B_lo from 5-period coverage of the ABAB partner tone: f₁ ≥ 5/(1/0.6−1/10) = 3.2 T → claims down to n ≈ 1.9×10¹²; onset itself is ≤ 0.3 T, censored — not binding; per-column δF = 0.64 T). **n = 3.2→1.0×10¹², N_n = 121** (3.1 samples per ray spacing at 0.6 T, above the ≥2 floor / at the prefer-3; Vtg 0.353→0.984 V, Vbg 0.351→1.166 V — inside validators). Light-tone trajectory at low n is reported resolution-limited, not claimed (f₁ < 3 T has < 5 periods). **Sensitivity 50 µV inherited from run 6** (5 kΩ FS at 10 nA; empirical worst-corner anchor: run 7 at |n| = 1.2×10¹² maxed 587 Ω at 10 T → ≥ 8× headroom; sacrifices nothing that run 6's 1.4%-FS SNR 40–100 didn't already survive). fast_delay = 1.8 s (6τ at τ = 0.3 s/24 dB — per-column-FFT discipline), slow_delay = 1.

**Coverage trade:** hole side excluded — the TG −0.3 V limit caps it at |n| ≤ 1.27×10¹², inside the model's close-balanced-pair exception regime; a hole fan cannot carry the call at any price this cooldown. Low-n electron columns (1.0–1.9×10¹²) ride along for trajectory shape but carry no standalone claims.

**Price:** 160 rows × (121 pts × ~2.35 s + turnaround) + 9.4 T ramp+settles (~77 min) ≈ 14.1 h computed → **~15 h realistic**. Ends at **10 T with gates at (n, D) = (1.0×10¹², 0)**; the LK mass ladder (Verify) rides the magnet down from there — no re-traverse.

**Checkpoints** (`hera-watch data --next --follow` armed): (1) first 3 rows (~15 min): signal level vs run 6, leakage, field tracking, no rail; (2) ~2 h in (B ≈ 0.75 T): row-digest drift check; (3) B ≈ 2 T (~row 119, ≈10 h): partial per-column FFT on landed rows (δF ≈ 0.86 T — light tone + heavy tone emerging on their Onsager curves) → continue / abandon call; abandoning then costs the remaining ~4 h. Leak guard trips at 1 nA. Abort = `nb-collab interrupt` (magnet holds; partial fan keeps its rows).

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`): electron side, D = 0, n-line 3.2 -> 1.0e12 (121 pts) fast, B 0.6 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (160 rows) slow ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_N, N_B = 121, 160
ns = np.linspace(3.2, 1.0, N_N)            # 1e12 cm^-2, descending along the row
Ds = np.zeros(N_N)                         # D = 0 line
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"n-line: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 at D = 0; Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f} V, "
      f"Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V")

# --- field axis: uniform in 1/B (per-column SdH-FFT fan), 1/3-Nyquist on F_L(3.2e12) = 33.6 T ---
invB = np.linspace(1 / 0.6, 1 / 10.0, N_B)
B_vec = 1.0 / invB                          # 0.6 -> 10 T ascending (magnet sits at 0)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
dinvB = abs(invB[1] - invB[0])
print(f"B: {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {N_B} rows, d(1/B) = {dinvB:.5f} 1/T "
      f"(Nyquist F = {1/(2*dinvB):.1f} T >= 33.6 needed x1.5)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan positions to 0.6 T itself), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- lock-in: inherit run 6 (50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA; worst-corner anchor run 7 max 587 Ohm) ---
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 1.0           # 6*tau at tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB (per-column-FFT discipline)
I_TRIP = 1e-9
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> ~10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, "
      f"slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), "
                  f"B 0.6 -> 10 T uniform-1/B {N_B} rows, {N_N}-pt n-line, sr1 50 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side, D = 0: n = {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts, paired n-line); '
              f'B = {B_vec[0]:.2f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.2f} T uniform-1/B ({N_B} rows, d(1/B) = {dinvB:.5f}); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'follows spot checks runs 6-7 (tones 7.1/22.2 T, sum 0.885 F_L)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B(slow), Vtg(fast), Vbg(fast), T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    # end state by design: B = 10 T (LK ladder rides down from here), gates parked at 0
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
    print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), "
          f"T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
